## About
Apex Alignment is a wheel alignment shop in Miami run by Albert Lazo, who has competed in motorsports for years and worked with Sportscar Club of America, National Auto Sport Association and Grand-American teams. He brings that same knowledge of alignment, corner balancing and suspension setup to your car.
We are not a "Toe & Go" shop. Driving style, modifications, how you use the vehicle and what you want out of it all go into the setup. Street cars and light trucks get the same quality of work, which can mean less tire wear and better fuel economy.
Customers rate us 4.9 on Google from 209 reviews. Not sure if your car needs an alignment? Bring it in for a free alignment check.

## Services
- Street alignment: Alignment for street vehicles and light trucks, with a vehicle print out. Some vehicles need extra adjustments, so price may vary. (Starting at $80)
- Race alignment: Alignment for track, autocross and race cars, with track specific setups available. (Starting at $100)
- Corner balancing: Corner balancing with setup and info sheets. Drag racing corner balancing is now available too. Does not include an alignment. (Starting at $200)
- Free alignment check: Bring your car in and we will tell you if it needs an alignment. (Free)
- High performance driver coaching: Coaching from an active high performance driving and race instructor.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Give us a call during morning business hours to get on the schedule.

Q: How long does an alignment take?
A: Most street alignments take about an hour and most race alignments take about an hour and a half.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: Yes. You can drop off your vehicle or wait at the shop.

Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: Cash, check, Discover, MasterCard, Visa and American Express. Prices include sales tax.

Q: Will I know the price before you start?
A: Yes. Some vehicles need extra adjustments, so we give you a price estimate before any work is done.
